description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue page in an online examination system. It manages session validation, database interactions to check and update course queue data, and handles button clicks for page navigation and grid selection events.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, managing course queue data and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, checks session variables, interacts with the database to verify course queue, and possibly deletes empty course queues.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin panel when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Reloads the current AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a row in the GridView, storing identifiers in session variables and transferring to ShowAns.aspx.
